notes: Original primary title and DOI verified in supplied canonical text. Rendered supplied PDF pages 6, 10 and 11 (printed pp. 163, 167–168). Final sample is explicitly 113 participants: 56 exposure and 57 checking. Exclusions: 10 incomplete Memory Questionnaires (5 each condition), 1 incomplete Stovetop Task (exposure), 3 incomplete STAI (2 checking, 1 exposure). Candidate arithmetic only: 56 + 57 = 113; recruitment accounting 127 - 10 - 1 - 3 = 113. No N inferred from degrees of freedom. Because row-specific test correspondence remains unresolved, common sample N is retained only as a candidate for parent field-scope review. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Candidate printed partial eta-squared/F/p pairs: stimulus main effects confidence .28/F(1,108)=42.55/p<.001 (begins p.167), vividness .25/36.32/p<.001, detail .26/38.12/p<.001; time main effects confidence .39/67.82/p<.001, vividness .31/49.38/p<.001, detail .35/57.00/p<.001; stimulus-by-time confidence .50/109.15/p<.001, vividness .37/63.64/p<.001, detail .48/98.26/p<.001; confidence three-way .05/5.31/p=.023.
